issue.title: Track complete Boost.Regex compatibility and release acceptance
issue.body:
## Goal

Deliver the complete standalone pure Rust implementation of Boost.Regex 1.89.0 under ADR-0001 through ADR-0005. The user expanded execution on 2026-10-17 beyond the completed root PRIMARY prototype. Stage completion and green tests do not close this issue. Do not merge main, publish a release, or integrate librime-rs.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Every applicable public syntax, option and API has an implementation, upstream reference and compatibility evidence.
- [ ] Complete ICU77 PRIMARY/IDENTICAL keys, locale/tailoring, names, property aliases and character rules; preserve Unicode 16.0.0 / CLDR 47.
- [ ] Parsing, compilation, execution, all captures, replacement and iteration.
- [ ] Byte, UTF-8/16/32, native platform locale and custom-traits APIs with original input-unit positions.
- [ ] Error categories/positions, explicit resource errors and thread-sharing contracts.
- [ ] Applicable upstream tests, deterministic generation and fuzz regressions.
- [ ] Actual Windows x64/ARM64 MSVC, Linux x64/ARM64 glibc, macOS Intel/ARM64 evidence.
- [ ] Every ordinary search/capture/replacement workload <= 1.5x Boost; compile/complex/Unicode <= 2x; engine working memory <= 2x + 64 KiB under the fixed protocol.
- [ ] Public documentation, examples, approved exceptions and clean-checkout reproduction.
- [ ] SonarCloud and required format/lint/build/test gates pass without weakening thresholds.

## Current verified baseline

Commit b71b31e1345d4453273ba529574eea348c654613 records the root PRIMARY stage: 1,160,181 valid full keys, 11 expected invalid-input rejections, 28,108 full CE64 traces; complete Linux CI passed for source commit 9e57799. Historical Windows evidence is unchanged. The 145 ICU4X IDENTICAL differences and original empty IDENTICAL reference crashes remain recorded.

## Working records

Capability tracking: `docs/development/capability-matrix.json` and `docs/development/capability-matrix.md`.
Persistent continuation: `docs/development/handoff.md`.
Implementation branch: `work/root-primary-cloud`; PR #1 remains draft.
All scripts and durable non-build evidence are tracked outside target. Meaningful verified changes receive scoped English commit titles and bodies.

## Execution

Continue directly to the next ready capability after each verified commit. Ask only about an unavoidable change to an accepted contract or unavailable external permission/resource, and continue independent work.
